status_summary: Press reporting dated 2025-01-24 said the Fed, FDIC, OCC and CFTC had removed diversity office web pages and the SEC had removed its DEI page, while it was unclear whether any office had closed; Bloomberg Law reported on 2025-04-14 that the SEC's Office of Minority and Women Inclusion web page had disappeared. As of 2026-10-14 an SEC page for that office still describes it as active, with an acting director and diversity programs. On the SRO side, Nasdaq filed on 2025-01-21 an immediately effective rule change (SEC notice published 2025-01-30, 90 FR 8554) repealing its board diversity listing requirements to reflect a federal court's vacatur of the SEC's 2021 approval order. No closure of a financial regulator's diversity office, repeal of the statutory offices, or statute barring discrimination by securities regulators and SROs was found.

timeline.event: Nasdaq filed an immediately effective rule change (SR-NASDAQ-2025-007) repealing its board diversity listing requirements to reflect a federal court's vacatur of the SEC's 2021 approval order; the SEC notice was published 2025-01-30 at 90 FR 8554.
Press reporting said the Fed, FDIC, OCC, CFTC and SEC had removed DEI or diversity office web pages as of 2025-01-23, with the SEC's OMWI page still up at that time.
Bloomberg Law reported that the SEC's web page for its mandated Office of Minority and Women Inclusion had been removed, and that it was unclear whether the office still operated.

title: End DEI offices and race- or sex-based appointment rules at financial regulators and SROs
uncertainties: The SEC page for its Office of Minority and Women Inclusion, read on 2026-10-14 on sec.gov, still describes the office and its programs but shows a 2017 modified date and cites FY2023 materials, so it may be stale; the office's actual operation is unknown. The statutory basis (Dodd-Frank section 342) is from general knowledge. The Nasdaq repeal followed a court vacatur and an exchange filing that took effect on filing, so it reflects alignment with the recommendation, not an SEC policy choice; the Nasdaq rule required board diversity or an explanation, which is close to but not the same as a rule requiring appointments by race or sex. Federal Register API searches since 2025-01-20 for Office of Minority and Women Inclusion and for the joint diversity policies standards returned only an FDIC information collection renewal (2025-01-22), with no rescission found. CFTC action beyond web page removal was not found. Web page removals rest on news reports.
